title: English Practice Quiz 0866
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Customer Relations: A customer has waited for an hour. Best response:
options: I apologise for the wait. I will check the status for you
questions.explanation: Acknowledge the delay and offer a practical next step.

questions.question: Customer Relations: Professionalism includes:
questions.explanation: Professional conduct involves respectful and dependable behaviour.

questions.question: Customer Relations: A service standard describes:
Customer Relations: You do not know an answer. Say:
options: I will check the correct information for you
questions.explanation: It is honest and offers to find accurate information.

questions.question: Customer Relations: Customer feedback can help:
questions.explanation: Feedback reveals strengths and improvement opportunities.

questions.question: Customer Relations: A customer asks for a supervisor. You should:
Customer Relations: Which behaviour builds trust?
questions.explanation: Trust grows through accuracy and reliability.

questions.question: Customer Relations: Close a service request when:
options: the action is completed and recorded

questions.question: Customer Relations: A professional apology should be:
questions.explanation: A sincere apology acknowledges the issue directly.
